components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button for saving, confirming, or triggering AI.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #d97757; color: #ffffff; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #c46243; transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.description: Monospace tag badge for categorization and filtering.

components.name: Search Input

components.html: ⌘K
components.css: .ds-input-wrapper { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; width: 100%; max-width: 400px; } .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #18181c; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); color: #f9fafb; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 36px 8px 12px; font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; outline: none; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #e08264; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #e08264; } .ds-kbd { position: absolute; right: 10px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); color: #9ca3af; padding: 2px 5px; border-radius: 4px; }

narrative.overview: OmniLink AI combines the high-density keyboard-driven speed of Linear & Raycast with the deep editorial sanctuary of modern reading tools. The interface prioritizes instant information scanning, structured metadata tags, and crisp semantic typography while remaining completely distraction-free.
keyCharacteristics: Terracotta Accent Mastery: Warm terracotta (#d97757 / #e08264) anchors focus without visual fatigue.
Duality of Voices: Precision sans (Outfit) for triage alongside editorial serif (Newsreader) for long-form reading.
Subtle Surface Layering: Tonal background contrast with 1px borders instead of heavy shadows.
Keyboard-First Rhythm: Monospace shortcut keycaps and sub-100ms transitions.

rules.name: The Focused Accent Rule
rules.body: Terracotta accent is strictly reserved for user-directed focus, active states, and AI badges. It must never coat more than 8% of the viewport area.

rules.name: The Quiet Surface Rule
rules.body: In dark mode, depth is expressed by lightening background surface luminosity by 3–5% per tier rather than increasing shadow opacity.

dos: Do maintain strict WCAG AA contrast (≥ 4.5:1) for all text in both dark and light modes.
Do provide monospace keyboard shortcut indicators (⌘K, J/K, ESC) next to primary actions.
Do use Newsreader serif exclusively for Reader Mode body and display headlines.
donts: Don't apply harsh saturated blue or neon highlights; stay within the refined Terracotta palette.
Don't clutter bookmark cards with more than 3 visible tags by default.
Don't use heavy drop shadows without a bounding border in dark mode.
